$description: Samriddhi's dated rules. Every rule names its primary source, the day it was checked (asOf) and the day it must be checked again (reviewBy, two months on). Amounts are in minor units (pence). Edit, then run `cargo test -p samriddhi-core catalogue`.

rules.note: MoneyHelper suggests three to six months of essential costs in an instant access account; three is the floor.
Debt that costs more than savings earn is usually cheaper to pay off first. 10% a year is our line for 'high'.
In the 2026 to 2027 tax year, the most you can save in ISAs is £20,000.
The ISA allowance stays £20,000 in 2027/28, and all of it can still go into cash ISAs: Budget 2026 dropped the planned £12,000 cash limit.
In some schemes the employer can pay in more than the legal minimum, often when you pay in more.
A goal with an amount and a date makes saving easier to plan and keep up.
FCA guidance keeps the risk a person is willing to take (attitude) apart from the loss they could absorb (capacity for loss).
